profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Calix
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the telecommunication industry.  Strong communication skills to sort out the customer requirements.  Strong technical skill to take customer requirements and deliver quality software.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
• I am the component owner for all VoIP related tickets and EPICs.  I triage on all VoIP tickets from the field and test teams, assign each ticket to the appropriate owner of prospective area or fix the ticket if it is in my area
• I am a key leader/contributor for the following projects with agile software development methodologies.
Implementation of the OMCI for GPON/XGS VoIP services including SIP, H.248 and MGCP
• TR104 which is part of TR69 for VoIP, defined vendor specific TR104 object to support Calix provisioning for SIP, MGCP, H.248, implemented and delivered the software on schedule
• VoIP provisioning model for Centurylink, participated in the weekly conference call with Centurylink, implemented and delivered the software on schedule
• VoIP provisioning model, alarms, open OMCI for Verizon, participated in the weekly conference call with Verizon, implemented and delivered the software on schedule
• Distilled the customer requirements and designed the interface between platform and voice group
• I provide feedback/request to propose new ONU management and control interface (OMCI) MEs that then get proposed to G.988.  Some of the contribution are for Verizon's open OMCI standard.
positions.insights: Skills: C (Programming Language) · Troubleshooting · Communication · Programming

positions.title: Software Engineer IV
positions.description:
Ericsson GPON EDA1500 (fiber access) product, key customer included AT&T
•	Worked on the Ethernet pack (G28 and E28), redesigned redundancy MAC synchronization with EFP, solved protection switch recover time, and solved many scalability related issues in various protocol areas such as MACFF, DHCP Ipv4/Ipv6, PPPoE, and ARP
•	Brought up the voice part of the multiple dwelling unit (MDU) from proto board to production by collaborating with OEM vendor to sort out hardware issues
•	Designed and integrated AudioCodes DSP, and Silicon Labs SLACs for the MDU project
•	Worked on ONU management and control interface (OMCI), Text CLI, alarms, various SIP and H.248 features and solved interoperability test issues on various ONTs (SFU and MDU)
positions.insights: Skills: C (Programming Language) · Troubleshooting · Communication · Programming

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Ported application protocols from Avalanche(Intel platform) to Spirent Test Center (MIPS platform), porting requires modifying and testing each protocol that Avalanche supports such as RTSP, FTP, HTTP,…etc, most porting issues were Little Endian versus Big Endian
•	Implemented protocol negotiation, session setup and authentication, authentication implementation includes LM, LMv2, NTLM, NTLM2 session response, NTLM version 2 challenge responses, open SSL library was used for the encryption algorithm
•	Ported Samba code to utilize GSS-API/SPNEGO and NTLM state machine
positions.insights: Skills: C (Programming Language) · Troubleshooting · Communication · Programming

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed and integrated RTCP (Real time control protocol) per RFC 1889
•	Responsible for ISUP (ISDN User Part) features such as Dual seizure, Signaling timeslot selection and Maintenance features such as circuit selection, circuit blocking and none-blocking
•	Responsible for software component called "hardware manager" that manages H.110 TDM backplane interface such as dynamic timeslot mapping
•	Responsible for rewriting the session manager that includes session setup, Megaco/H.248 (Media Gateway Control Protocol) to interface the main controller and the DSP
positions.insights: Skills: Real-Time Transport Protocol (RTP) · C (Programming Language) · Troubleshooting · Communication · C++ · Programming

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Responsible for design and integration of DSP, Telephony, and signaling drivers to communicate with Jetstream, Coppercom, Zhone, and tdSoft Voice Gateway
•	Lead designer working with Hardware group to bring up new PCB and perform on-site debug/integration with Gateway partners in the inter-op labs
positions.insights: Skills: C (Programming Language) · Troubleshooting · Communication · Programming

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: •	Software Design Prime for protection switching recovery mechanism that included call audit and channel audit for ATM, T1, and Gateway System Controller
positions.insights: Skills: C (Programming Language) · Troubleshooting · Communication · Programming

positions.title: Senior software engineer
positions.description:
•	Responsible of software driver development for FXS, E&M, and T1/E1 Digital Voice boards for Voice over ATM network gateway, supporting AAL2 adaptation types
•	Responsible for software driver development for digit collection/dialing on DTMF, Dial Pulse, MFR1, and MFR2 compelled registering dialing
positions.insights: Skills: C (Programming Language) · Troubleshooting · Communication · Programming

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
UMC1000 is a Digital Loop Carrier equipment
•	Call Control Software design and implementation on ADSL solution on UMC1000 system
•	Member of Software Design Team in GR-303 solution on UMC1000. My involvement included CPU redundancy, Call Setup/Tear Down, ISDN D-Channel multiplexer, and Synchronization between two main controllers CPU and DLP.  DLP is a slave controller that does Q.931 and Q.921 functions to the switch interface
•	Designed UMC code to support HFC project for new CPU hardware that includes the new database FLASH driver and database management code
•	Designed features that includes Automatic Home Terminal Registration/Management, and Concentrated Call Control, Frequency Agility, Redundancy, Alarm, Backward Compatibility, and Database on Tellabs’ Cablespan products
positions.insights: Skills: C (Programming Language) · Troubleshooting · Communication · Programming

positions.title: Member of Technical staff
positions.description:
•	Designed Intra-terminal Messaging Protocol between main controller APC (Access Processor Card) and DMC (D-link Modem Card).
•	Designed In-service software download, Flash Memory device driver, Automatic wallbox registration and management, Frequency Agility, Craft port user Interface for cable phone
•	Lead a co-op to offload my workload
positions.insights: Skills: C (Programming Language) · Troubleshooting · Communication · Programming

honors.title: Employee of the month at Ericsson
honors.description: Received the honor for the MDU project which I had put in lots of extra hours to bring up the board from proto type to product quality.
honors.issuer: Issued by Software Director of Ericsson · Feb 2010
